skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Dreaming High
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Dreaming High. With high-grade sandbeast feed on a Rim Billiton regional audition's prize list, Ray doesn't mind taking on a new challenge.
skins.quote: Ray's not entirely sure what 'stage decorations' are supposed to be, but after consulting with Lanns and Potlid, she decided to use a mine excavator as the 'main visual' thingamabob.
